description: This file contains implementation code for NTLM authentication support using Windows SSPI in the curl project. It includes functions to check NTLM support, create NTLM messages (type 1 and type 3), decode type 2 messages, and clean up NTLM credentials.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_is_ntlm_supported(void)
methods.description: Checks if NTLM is supported by the Windows SSPI security package.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_ntlm_type1_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,const char * service,const char * host,struct ntlmdata * ntlm,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates an NTLM type-1 message for authentication handshake.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_decode_ntlm_type2_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const struct bufref * type2,struct ntlmdata * ntlm)
methods.description: Decodes an NTLM type-2 message received from the server.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_ntlm_type3_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,struct ntlmdata * ntlm,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates an NTLM type-3 message in response to a challenge.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_cleanup_ntlm(struct ntlmdata * ntlm)
methods.description: Cleans up NTLM authentication data and resources.
